turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Watch one example first.
"I see an owl." Owl starts with the sound "o". That is a vowel sound, so I use an.
Rule: we write an before a vowel sound, and a before other sounds.
Right: It is a hat. Wrong: It is an hat.

Now try this. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
turns.judgeInput:
KNOWLEDGE STATE (before this tutor turn):
Target form: articles. Learner level A1. First language Arabic.
W1 (wrong) strength 3: no a/an is needed before a singular noun. Its error: leaves out a/an ("She is teacher").
W2 (wrong) strength 1: a and an are the same; "a" (or "the") goes everywhere. Its error: uses "a" where "an" is needed ("a apple").
C1 (correct) strength 0: a singular countable noun needs a/an (or the). Independent correct productions so far: 0.
C2 (correct) strength 0: an before a vowel sound, a before a consonant sound. Independent correct productions so far: 0.
